name: ai-seo-squad
description: Single-agent GEO squad: GEO-agent runs daily citation audits, writes GEO-optimized blog posts, and ships llms.txt / JSON-LD engineering PRs.
author: pancake-official

workflows.summary: Audit ChatGPT/Gemini/Perplexity citation share for the target keywords and file the delta.

keywords.description: Comma-separated keywords to audit AI-engine citation share for (defaults to the team.target_keywords vault value).

domain.description: Apex domain whose citation share is measured (defaults to the team.target_domain vault value).

workflows.outcome: Per-keyword citation-share table filed to wiki, rolling trend updated, and the three-line delta filed on the board.

workflows.summary: Write a GEO-optimized blog post and ship it as a self-merged PR (or wiki draft).

topic.example: How AI agents qualify outbound leads

keyword.description: Target keyword to win an AI-engine citation for.

workflows.outcome: Blog post drafted to the content repo, PR opened and self-merged (or filed to wiki/Knowledge/GEO/Drafts when no repo).

workflows.summary: Ship an llms.txt / JSON-LD / schema / metadata GEO fix as a self-merged PR.

target.description: Which technical GEO surface to ship.

scope.description: Page or site section to scope the fix to (defaults to the whole site).

workflows.outcome: Technical GEO fix opened and self-merged as a PR; change filed to wiki/Knowledge/GEO.

workflows.summary: Roll up the week's citation-share trend and movement into a digest.
workflows.outcome: Weekly citation-share trend digest filed to wiki and summarized on the board.

required_identities.reason: GEO-agent pushes drafted blog posts and llms.txt / schema changes to your content repo.

required_vault_secrets.label: Top 5 keywords for AI engine citation (comma-separated)
